needed.evidence: footway is under 1m and partly blocked by obstructions
needed.suggestion: Install a continuous, usable sidewalk of at least 1m width on the left side to ensure safe pedestrian movement.

needed.evidence: footway is partly blocked by parked vehicles and other obstructions
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions and ensure the left footway is clear for pedestrian use.

needed.evidence: uneven sections and trip hazards on the footway
needed.suggestion: Repair and level the footway to eliminate trip hazards on the left side.

needed.evidence: marked crossing without adequate safety features
needed.suggestion: Install a refuge island or traffic signals to improve the safety of the marked crossing.

needed.evidence: crossing quality is poor due to lack of driver attention and visibility issues
